title: BankPinnedPayload

bankId.description: A bank's id: a version 4 UUID the registering client mints, kept in lowercase.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

pointer.description: A folder pointer bank:org/[project/[area/]], or a topic pointer bank:org/project/[area/]memories/topic/: a pin expands it whole.

description: bank.pinned: a session pinned or unpinned a folder of a bank.
